input.notes: Standup, Tuesday. Ravi: shipped the export fix, picking up the CSV importer today. Sara: still blocked on the staging cert, will ping infra this morning. Tom is out sick. Decision: we hold the 2.1 release until the cert is sorted.

action_items.task: Ping infra about the staging cert

name: planning, unowned work goes to the lead

input.notes: Planning call. Maya ran it. We agreed the onboarding rewrite lands this quarter. Someone needs to write the migration doc before we start, and the pricing page copy still needs a rewrite - nobody picked it up. Maya will book time with legal next week.
Company all-hands. Finance walked through the Q3 numbers. Revenue up 12%. No new commitments; questions were answered live.

name: incident review, owner inferred from a team

input.notes: Incident review for the Friday outage. Root cause was the expired cert. The oncall rota clearly needs a secondary - the platform team owns that. Dana is writing the postmortem by Thursday. We decided not to roll back 2.0.

name: client call, a customer wish is not an action

input.notes: Client call with Northwind. They want SSO by the end of the month. Priya said she'd chase the vendor before Friday. We promised a written scope by next Wednesday - Alex has it. Northwind will confirm budget on their side.
Retro. Mood was flat. Things that went badly: the release checklist was ignored, and nobody updated the runbook. Both need fixing before the next release. No one volunteered.

name: one-on-one, the only attendee holds it

input.notes: 1:1 with Jonas. He's taking over the billing alerts. The dashboard cleanup is still open - we didn't say who. Jonas thinks it's a two-day job. Agreed he moves to the payments squad in September.

name: weekly sync, chatter mixed with commitments

input.notes: Weekly sync, lots of ground. Started late. Ben mentioned the analytics job has been failing quietly since the 3rd - he'll fix it today. Then we went off on the hiring pipeline for a while; nothing decided there. Sara raised that the docs site is a mess, she'll do a pass this week if she has time. Tom wants to move the standup to 9:30 - everyone shrugged, so we're leaving it. Oh and the security questionnaire from Northwind is due next Friday, Ben said he'd start it but Sara has the compliance context.

Architecture review. We compared Postgres and DynamoDB for the events table and settled on Postgres for now, though we'll revisit if write volume triples. Nothing to do until the load test numbers come back.

name: ops sync spanning every due bucket

input.notes: Ops sync. Dana: the backup restore test has to happen today, it's overdue. Ravi will rotate the API keys this week. Maya's taking the vendor review next week. And at some point this month someone should tidy the terraform - Ravi said he'd try.

name: roadmap planning, owners inferred from roles

input.notes: Roadmap planning. The mobile team will take the offline mode spike in Q4. Design owes us the empty states - Kim is design lead. We agreed to drop the tablet layout entirely.

name: budget chat, an owed answer with no owner

input.notes: Budget chat, 15 minutes. Nothing signed off. Finance wants a number from us before the board meeting; we said we'd come back next week with one. Alex to pull last year's spend in the meantime.
